summary: Literal nyk has unexpressed, zero-marked nominal and suffixal partners. These are argument variants, not separate senses; sexual violence and marital contexts do not by themselves change the lexical meaning.
The new Infectum box includes nuyak-, nayk-, noyək and reduced nak- forms. nakwoli supplies Infectum-wa and nyoko supplies an Infinitiv.
Preterit kinship insults can function in present abuse rather than reporting completed intercourse; Infectum can form the same kind of curse. The money-object dismissal is independently figurative.
Searches for nəkli, qaḥfo and Nakno returned no existing collocation. Inherited wording and edition euphemisms are preserved.

Only manəknola is supplied, embedded in a conditional threat demanding money. The object -la resumes eme d emox; prospective gəd and the payment demand establish the threat use independently of the machine translation.

A new III stem is withheld: the m-initial shape is suggestive, but there is no contrasting form or secure base pair. The lookup form candidates are consonant heuristics, not confirmation of a III paradigm; manək search hits are unrelated word boundaries.
Round-1 I kinship-insult collocations are retained without re-proposal. The grandmother referent is a participant extension; no new collocation is indexed solely to lengthen the kinship chain.
Confirm kmənoki as Detransitive Infectum plural rather than another m-prefixed form; its patient-like interpretation is strongly supported by the same-verse active contrast.
Confirm reduced nakwoli and the relation among noyək/nayk-/nak-.
PrS 12/21 omits nuyaknəx in German, and 58/66 omits its mother-taunt clause. Both were withheld as standalone examples.
101/12 has an alignment flag and corrupted German. Recover the edition text; no translation from it has been quoted.
Check whether prs 27/4, 7 in the inherited example reflects another numbering system. The explicit 58/56 citation was replaced because that supplied verse contains a different use.
Confirm nyoko as Infinitiv within the glossary's system rather than a lexicalized noun.
PrS 2/22: determine the scope of b dugle and quotation punctuation; the allegation is not a factual assertion.
Confirm manəknola against the recording: III formation, another contact/dialect form of I, or a source issue? Elicit the corresponding Preterit/Infectum bases before adding a III stem.
All Jan English is machine translation. Confirm the conditional/dlo linkage and grandmother referent; no actual event is inferred from this threatened insult.

The grandmother-directed sexual threat extends the kinship-insult inventory already proposed in round 1. No actual sexual event is asserted and no new insulting sense is required. The printed manəknola has an unresolved stem assignment and is not filed as a secure I form.
